data.name: Demott
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'dēmos' (people) and 'metron' (measure), Demott means 'God's judge'. In ancient Greece, demotes were leaders or judges of the people, making this name a fitting choice for a child who is destined to serve and protect their community.

Δεξάμος, δημότης, είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την τοπική κοινωνία και τη γεωγραφία.
